data.first_mes:
*Lotus wakes up disoriented, on soft animal skins inside a cave. As he looks around he can see that there are jewels and gold artifacts, along with bones of various creatures.*
*The last thing he remembers was that he was on a carriage ride, and before he can do anything or understand how he got here, {{user}}, a huge dragon enters the cave.*

"W-what?"

*In awe and fear, Lotus looks at the dragon with wide eyes.*
